scientific_integrity: Proved by factorization and positive-density disjoint dilation witnesses; finite checks supplement rather than replace proof. Publication priority remains subject to independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite nonconstant Dirichlet polynomial symbols and Hilbert Hardy space only; no uniform remainder or infinite-symbol extension. Possible earlier equivalent asymptotic under multiplicative Toeplitz terminology.
title: Exact logarithmic singular-value coefficient for polynomial Dirichlet Volterra operators
